<!--
How to use this tracker:
- Check off tasks as they land, one checkbox per concrete, file-referenced step.
- EVERY agent/person that touches this issue MUST refresh the Status block at the
  top before finishing: Status, Latest update, Last updated by. This is the first
  thing the next agent reads when picking up the work.
- Update Handoff notes with what is verified, what is blocked, and exactly what
  the next step is. Keep notes short and specific; link PRs instead of pasting diffs.
- Do NOT delete or reword checked-off tasks; move finished detail into Notes if needed.
-->

## Status

- **Status**: 🟡 In progress
- **Latest update**: _fill in — date — what changed and what is next_
- **Last updated by**: _fill in — name or agent_

## Checklist

<!-- One checkbox per concrete task, with the file/area it touches. -->
- [ ] _task — file/area_

## Handoff notes

<!-- What the next agent needs: verified so far, blockers, exact next step. -->

## Notes

<!-- Links to PRs, decisions, and anything else worth keeping. -->
